title: The archive keeps more than a look
governingQuestion: What must survive if a Fashion Week wants its claims—not only its images—to remain auditable?
rightsBoundary: Protected invitations, films, backstage photography and organizer interfaces remain authorized-embed, link-only, or permission candidates. No reproduction right is inferred from public access.

beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Copenhagen turns participation into an evidence problem: admission, time, teardown, rights, screening, product data and institutional memory each demand a record. This chapter follows memory: The venue disappears, schedules change and links decay; preservation choices determine which technical history remains citable and contestable.
beats.onScreen: Then: CPHFW retains schedule, framework, article and reporting surfaces while Designmuseum Danmark preserves fashion and textiles through collection-based interpretation.
beats.credit: Scandinavian Academy of Fashion Design · CC BY-SA 4.0

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: CPHFW retains schedule, framework, article and reporting surfaces while Designmuseum Danmark preserves fashion and textiles through collection-based interpretation. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Policy evidence, show media, production records and museum objects travel under different access and reuse rules; no single archive currently joins them.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: No complete public record was located for every CPHFW show’s invitations, crew credits, production data, screening evidence, media rights, product records and long-term preservation.
